summary: A pipe (|) sends stdout of the left command to stdin of the right command.
> writes output to a file (overwrite). >> appends output to a file.
Single quotes keep text literal. Double quotes still expand variables and command substitution.
Command substitution runs a command and inserts its output, usually with $(...).
chmod changes read/write/execute permission bits for files and directories.
find locates files/paths by metadata, while grep searches text content inside files or streams.
